title: lichen-gw GET endpoints answer OSCORE-protected peers in plaintext (GCP-6.4 downgrade)
description: coap_slot_coord.c:969-971 (slots_get), :1103-1105 (info_get), :1140-1142 (channels_get) respond via plain lichen_coap_respond and never call coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request — Zephyr dispatches OSCORE-protected GETs to them and the full allocation map / gateway info / channel ownership returns as cleartext 2.05, silently dropping the protected peer's confidentiality expectation (spec/08:104 'All CoAP messages use OSCORE'). The post-gate slots_post is consistent; the sibling GETs are not. Fix: route through unprotect + coap_oscore_respond_resource like slots_post, or explicitly document them as public and drop the decorative OSCORE handling.
